eu-roadworthiness.name: EU periodic technical inspection
eu-roadworthiness.description: The full Annex I checklist from Directive 2014/45/EU, graded on the minor / major / dangerous defect scale. Thresholds are pre-filled with the common Union figures — adjust them to your national test.

eu-roadworthiness-motorcycle.name: EU inspection — motorcycles (L category)
eu-roadworthiness-motorcycle.description: Annex I reduced to the checks that apply to two- and three-wheelers, with tread limits set for L-category vehicles.

no-eu-kontroll.name: Norway — EU-kontroll
no-eu-kontroll.description: Statens vegvesen's kontrollinstruks 4.1 for passenger cars and vans up to 3500 kg, with the instruks' own numbering, defect reasons, grades and limits. Check for a newer version of the instruks before issuing certificates.

de-hauptuntersuchung.name: Germany — Hauptuntersuchung
de-hauptuntersuchung.description: Annex I arranged for the German main inspection under §29 StVZO. Confirm the current HU-Richtlinie limits before issuing certificates.

nl-apk.name: Netherlands — APK
nl-apk.description: Annex I arranged for the Dutch APK. Confirm the current RDW requirements before issuing certificates.

standard-multipoint.name: Standard multi-point inspection
standard-multipoint.description: A general workshop health check covering the major systems. Graded pass / attention / fail rather than on the EU defect scale.

pre-purchase.name: Pre-purchase inspection
pre-purchase.description: Buyer-facing report covering documentation, body, mechanicals and wear items, with room for measurements and photos.

ev-hybrid.name: Electric and hybrid vehicle check
ev-hybrid.description: High-voltage safety, traction battery health and charging, plus the conventional items that behave differently on an electrified drivetrain.

marine.name: Marine vessel inspection
marine.description: Hull, propulsion, electrical and safety equipment for a boat, with engine hours in place of an odometer reading.

blank.name: Blank template
blank.description: Start from nothing and build the checklist your workshop actually uses.

vehicle-intake.name: Vehicle check-in
vehicle-intake.description: The walk-round at drop-off, done with the customer standing there: how the car arrived, what was already on the body, what was left inside. Prints on the work order the customer signs.

descriptions.no_0_1: Check the plates against the registration certificate or the NPRA's electronic records, and for damage, visibility and position. A deregistered vehicle gets no defect for missing plates.
descriptions.no_0_2: Check the stamped VIN against the registration certificate. For Euro 5 and newer, and electric vehicles first registered on or after 1 January 2011, also read the VIN from OBD with a diagnostic tool. Defects d) and e) are not given when the only difference is I versus 1 or O versus 0; when given, point 10.1 must also be marked.
descriptions.no_1_1_1: Vehicles with a brake servo are checked with the engine off.
descriptions.no_1_1_2: Vehicles with a brake servo are checked with the engine off.
descriptions.no_1_1_3: Check the time needed to reach a safe working pressure and how many times the brake can be applied after the engine is stopped. Defects a) and f) are grade 2 if the brake cannot be applied at least 4 times (engine off for hydraulic brakes), grade 3 if fewer than 2 times.
descriptions.no_1_1_10: Stop the engine and pump the pedal, press it very slowly to reveal internal leakage and creep, then start the engine and check the pedal is drawn in. Brake fluid below minimum is grade 1, well below minimum grade 2, and no visible fluid grade 3.
descriptions.no_1_1_12: Bend the hose to judge cracks. Visible cord is a defect.
descriptions.no_1_1_13: Visual check, through inspection holes in the backplate where fitted.
descriptions.no_1_1_14: Rust is judged on the pad contact area of the disc, measured radially. Defect e) is not given if there is no backplate. Light vehicles (permitted total weight up to and including 3500 kg): rust defect when more than 25 % of one side of a front-axle disc is rusted (f), and more than 50 % of one side of a disc on other axles (g).
descriptions.no_1_1_16: Covers hydraulic cylinders, including wheel cylinders and brake calipers, checked while the brake is applied.
descriptions.no_1_1_17: A mechanical valve is checked against the values on the load-sensing data plate; for electronic load sensing use the vehicle's warning function.
descriptions.no_1_1_23: Hydraulic system: check that the circuit failure warning lamp works and is not lit constantly.
descriptions.no_1_2_1: Apply the brakes progressively up to maximum effort on a roller tester, or on a road test when that is not possible. Defect g) is given when the test cannot be done because of the climate. Imbalance between wheels on the same axle: more than 30 % of the highest value is grade 2, more than 50 % on the front axle of a motor vehicle is grade 3. Fluctuation max 30 daN for permitted total weight up to and including 3500 kg, regardless of the braking force chosen. Braking force should not exceed 1800 daN per wheel during the test.
descriptions.no_m_imbalance_front: Difference in braking force between the wheels, as % of the higher value. Over 30 % is defect b) at grade 2, over 50 % on the front axle is grade 3.
descriptions.no_m_imbalance_rear: Difference in braking force between the wheels, as % of the higher value. Over 30 % is defect b) at grade 2.
descriptions.no_1_2_2: Brake each axle with increasing force on the roller tester and judge total efficiency on a test drive, with a decelerometer when in doubt. If the vehicle cannot be tested on rollers, use a decelerometer on the road from at least 30 km/h; defect d) is given when the test cannot be done, for example because of the climate. Minimum braking efficiency. Registered on or after 1 January 2012: passenger car (M1) 58 %, van/combined vehicle with permitted total weight not over 3500 kg (N1) 50 %. Registered before 1 January 2012: passenger car (M1) 50 %, N1 registered 1.10.92 or later 50 %, N1 registered before 1.10.92 45 %. Road test with decelerometer: m/s² times 10 gives deceleration in %, and 35 % or lower is defect e). Front/rear brake force distribution is normally 60/40.
descriptions.no_m_efficiency_m1_2012: Requirement 58 %. Fill in the row that applies to the vehicle.
descriptions.no_m_efficiency_other: Passenger car (M1) registered before 1 Jan 2012 and van (N1): 50 %. Van (N1) registered before 1.10.92: 45 %. Fill in the row that applies to the vehicle.
descriptions.no_1_4_1: Test on the roller tester, or on the road when that is not possible; on a road test defect a) is given if the vehicle deviates strongly from a straight line. The manufacturer's test method may also be used.
descriptions.no_1_4_2: The parking brake must hold the vehicle stationary on a given gradient. With a hydraulic service brake it is enough to judge it on a slope of known gradient or by another suitable method. Registered before 1.10.92: 16 % gradient (9.1°, z = 0.158). Registered after 1.10.92: 18 % gradient (10.2°, z = 0.177), and the motor vehicle must also hold the combination at permitted train weight on 12 % (6.8°).
descriptions.no_m_parking_brake: Must hold the vehicle on an 18 % slope (z = 0.177). Registered before 1.10.92: 16 % slope (z = 0.158).
descriptions.no_1_6: Check both that the warning lamp shows no fault and that the self-diagnosis works, for example the lamp lights at start and goes out afterwards or during the test drive.
descriptions.no_1_8: Visual check and boiling point measurement. Defect b) when the boiling point is below 150 degrees Celsius.
descriptions.no_2_1_1: Turn the steering wheel lock to lock with the wheels lifted or on turntables and check the steering gear operation visually. Leakage under f) applies to vehicles without power steering; with power steering, leakage is assessed under 2.1.5.
descriptions.no_2_1_2: Turn the steering wheel both ways, or use a play detector, with the wheels on the ground, and check the attachment of the rack/steering box visually.
descriptions.no_2_1_3: Turn the steering wheel both ways, or use a play detector, with the wheels on the ground, and check the components for wear, fractures and security.
descriptions.no_2_1_4: Turn the steering wheel lock to lock with the weight on the wheels and, for power steering, the engine running, and check the moving components.
descriptions.no_2_1_5: Check for leaks and fluid level (if visible), and that the power steering works with the wheels on the ground and the engine running. Low fluid is grade 1 when the level is below minimum but there is fluid in the reservoir.
descriptions.no_2_2_1: Pull and push the steering wheel in line with the column and at right angles to it, with the vehicle's weight on the wheels.
descriptions.no_2_2_2: Turn, pull and push the steering wheel with the weight on the wheels, and check play and the condition of flexible couplings and universal joints.
descriptions.no_2_3: Gently turn the steering wheel both ways as far as possible without moving the wheels, with the weight on the wheels, wheels straight ahead and the engine running for power steering.
descriptions.no_2_4: Visual assessment of whether one or more wheels are obviously seriously misaligned, without measuring equipment. Unevenly worn tyres alone are not a defect (tyres are assessed under 5.2.3).
descriptions.no_2_6: Visual check and check that steering wheel and wheel angles match when the engine is started and switched off.
descriptions.no_3_1: Visual check from the driver's seat.
descriptions.no_3_2: Check the windscreen and front side windows for vision only, including wear against glare and reflective or tinted film (recorded under i). k) is recorded when the side window is lowered and cannot be checked, and is cleared at re-inspection only if the window meets the requirements. Within the field of view, no damage over 10 mm across is accepted, including the matte spot left after a repair. Field of view on motor vehicles up to and including 3500 kg permitted total weight: 30 cm wide, centred on the steering wheel and within the wiper sweep area.
descriptions.no_3_3: Faults in the mirror adjustment device are not recorded if the mirror can be adjusted by hand on the mirror itself.
descriptions.no_3_6: A defect is recorded if the defroster fan is defective and/or no air reaches the windscreen.
descriptions.no_4_1_2: Check dipped and main beam of each headlamp with a headlamp aim tester. c) is cleared at re-inspection only if the lamps are correctly aimed. Use the manufacturer's inclination, otherwise 1 %. A defect is recorded if the cut-off line still deviates when the aim tester is set to the vehicle's inclination +-1 percentage point (e.g. 1.5 % gives 0.5 % to 2.5 %); the same tolerance applies sideways. The inclination must in any case be at least 0.5 % (a stated 1 % gives an accepted range of 0.5 % to 2 %).
descriptions.no_m_headlamp_aim: The manufacturer's inclination ±1 percentage point, and never under 0.5 %. Without a stated value 1 % applies, so 0.5 to 2.0 % downwards. Adjust the limits when the manufacturer states another value.
descriptions.no_4_1_4: Assess, or measure with a lux meter, whether the light is strong enough.
descriptions.no_4_1_5: Covers only levelling required because of the light source type, not manual levelling (see 4.1.2).
descriptions.no_4_1_6: Defective headlamp cleaners on filament or halogen lamps are not a defect.
descriptions.no_4_4_4: Check whether the flashing rate obviously deviates from the requirements.
descriptions.no_4_5_2: Checked with a headlamp aim tester. b) is cleared at re-inspection only if the lamps are correctly aimed. Use the manufacturer's inclination, otherwise 1.5 %. A defect is recorded if the cut-off line still deviates when the aim tester is set to the vehicle's inclination +-1 percentage point (e.g. 1.5 % gives 0.5 % to 2.5 %); the same tolerance applies sideways. The inclination must in any case be at least 0.5 % (a stated 1 % gives an accepted range of 0.5 % to 2 %).
descriptions.no_4_10: Check the trailer socket with suitable equipment; it must be wired to the ISO standard. For lighting, only rear, stop and direction indicator lamps are checked.
descriptions.no_4_11: Visual check under the vehicle and in the engine compartment where relevant.
descriptions.no_4_12: Covers among others aftermarket extra lamps (extra main beam, fog lamps, underbody lights, rotating beacons, light bars, work lights) and taxi roof signs. i) is cleared at re-inspection only if the lamps are correctly aimed.
descriptions.no_4_13: Also check the main switch, fuses and ventilation where required. a) is recorded if poor or missing fastening creates a risk of short circuit.
descriptions.no_4_14_1: Visual inspection. Applies to electric and hybrid vehicles.
descriptions.no_4_14_2: Underbody coating or similar on the cable is not a defect as long as the cable is still easily recognisable as a propulsion cable.
descriptions.no_4_14_3: d) is not recorded if the owner only has a fixed charging station.
descriptions.no_5_1_1: Inspect over a pit or on a drive-on lift. Play detectors are recommended (mandatory only above 3500 kg).
descriptions.no_5_1_2: Apply a horizontal or vertical force to each wheel and watch for movement between stub axle and axle.
descriptions.no_5_1_3: Apply a horizontal force to each wheel and see how far it moves relative to the stub axle. Listen for noise.
descriptions.no_5_2_1: Visual check. More than 25 % of wheel nuts/studs missing on one wheel is grade 3.
descriptions.no_5_2_2: Check both sides of every rim. Rim size and offset differing from the registration document are accepted with manufacturer documentation, the original sticker or the owner's manual. An illegally fitted spacer is reason f).
descriptions.no_5_2_3: Check size, load index, speed index and approval mark against the registration document; load and speed index must cover the maximum permitted axle load and top speed. f) is for different construction (radial/bias, summer/winter), not a different make or pattern. Studless winter tyres on one axle and summer tyres on the other is not a defect, but a light vehicle with studded tyres must have them on all wheels. Tread depth is measured in the main grooves across the central three quarters of the tread width and judged against current technical and usage rules. The instruks gives no numeric limit.
descriptions.no_m_tread_summer: At least 1.6 mm, measured in the main grooves across the middle ¾ of the tread. The lowest reading counts. Regulation on the use of vehicles § 1-4.
descriptions.no_m_tread_winter: At least 3 mm for vehicles with a permitted total weight up to 3500 kg. The winter period is 1 November to the first Sunday after Easter Monday, and 16 October to 30 April in Nordland, Troms and Finnmark. Regulation on the use of vehicles § 1-4.
descriptions.no_5_3_2: Includes struts. b) is for serious leakage or loss of function; light seepage alone is not a defect.
descriptions.no_5_3_3: Also covers the arms' components and torque/propshaft tubes.
descriptions.no_5_3_5: Check air bags, levelling valves, lines and reservoirs for damage and listen for leaks.
descriptions.no_6_1_3: Also covers the tank and pipes/hoses of auxiliary heaters. Use a leak detector on LPG/CNG/LNG systems.
descriptions.no_6_1_4: Look for loose parts or damage that could injure someone on contact.
descriptions.no_6_1_5: Applies to externally mounted spare wheel carriers.
descriptions.no_6_1_6: Look for dangerous corrosion (use a rust pick if in doubt), damage and improper repair. Function testing of a detachable ball is not part of the inspection. y) applies when the coupling is obviously too weak for the gross/permitted trailer weight.
descriptions.no_6_1_7: k), l) and m) cover dust covers (boots) front and rear.
descriptions.no_6_1_8: Grade 2 when the mounting is badly deteriorated or obviously seriously damaged.
descriptions.no_6_1_9: Visual check for obvious alteration or modification.
descriptions.no_6_2_2: Inspect over a pit, on a jack stand lift or a drive-on lift.
descriptions.no_6_2_7: Visual and functional check of the controls needed to operate the vehicle safely.
descriptions.no_6_2_9: Also covers hydraulic hoses for fittings and equipment.
descriptions.no_7_1_3: Visual inspection for obvious faults or missing parts.
descriptions.no_7_1_4: Visual inspection for obvious faults or missing parts.
descriptions.no_7_1_5: Visual inspection for obvious faults or missing parts.
descriptions.no_7_1_6: Check both whether the malfunction indicator shows a fault and whether the self-diagnosis works correctly (on some models the lamp stays lit for a while after start and then goes out).
descriptions.no_7_2: Where a fire extinguisher is required, an approved extinguisher of the correct size must be fitted. Check that the gauge reads correctly and that the unit is marked with its last inspection date.
descriptions.no_7_3: Check that the ignition lock, steering lock or gear lock is in order. Only one of these is required.
descriptions.no_7_8: Visual inspection, or function check by road test or electronically. Check the illumination.
descriptions.no_7_12: Check both whether the malfunction indicator shows a fault and whether the self-diagnosis works correctly (on some models the lamp stays lit for a while after start and then goes out).
descriptions.no_7_14_1: Applies only to M1 and N1 vehicles required to have eCall by their type approval.
descriptions.no_7_14_2: Applies only to M1 and N1 vehicles required to have eCall by their type approval.
descriptions.no_7_14_3: Visual check of the audio components (speaker/microphone). Applies only to M1 and N1 vehicles required to have eCall by their type approval.
descriptions.no_8_1_1: Registered before 1 Oct 1992: observe the noise level. Registered after 1 Oct 1992: if the system is original or equivalent with no audible leaks, judge the noise with a throttle blip from idle; if in doubt, measure (stationary, engine warm, rpm from the registration certificate or 3/4 of max-power rpm, at least 3 readings, highest counts). Defect when the measured level exceeds the stated level by more than 5 dB(A) if stated by the manufacturer (F), or by more than 2 dB(A) if measured by a laboratory (L). A measurement is valid when 3 consecutive readings differ by no more than 2 dB(A); calibration drift over 1 dB invalidates the test. Background noise at least 10 dB(A) below the measured level. Microphone 0.5 m from the outlet at 45 degrees to the side.
descriptions.no_8_2_1_2: Euro 4 or lower: measure with a gas analyser; manufacturer limits take precedence over the general ones. Euro 5 and newer: read OBD with diagnostic equipment; no tailpipe test when the ECU responds, the readiness test is OK and there are no active engine fault codes (P0 to P6). Otherwise measure as for Euro 4. A leak or deliberate modification that prevents measurement gives d). Exempt: vehicles registered before 1974 and two-stroke engines. Without three-way catalyst and lambda sensor (CO at idle, engine warm): 4.5% for vehicles registered 1 Jan 1974 to 1 Oct 1986; 3.5% registered after 1 Oct 1986. With three-way catalyst and lambda sensor, older than Euro 3: idle 0.5%, high idle 0.3%. Euro 3 or newer: idle 0.3%, high idle 0.2%. High idle at least 2000 rpm; lambda 1 ± 0.03. Probe at least 30 cm into the tailpipe; multiple pipes use the average.
descriptions.no_m_co_idle_euro3: With three-way catalyst and lambda sensor: max 0.3 %. The manufacturer's limit takes precedence. Euro 5 and newer are only measured when the OBD check is not in order.
descriptions.no_m_co_high_idle_euro3: At least 2000 rpm: max 0.2 %. The manufacturer's limit takes precedence.
descriptions.no_m_co_idle_pre_euro3: With three-way catalyst and lambda sensor, older than Euro 3: max 0.5 %. The manufacturer's limit takes precedence.
descriptions.no_m_co_high_idle_pre_euro3: At least 2000 rpm: max 0.3 %. The manufacturer's limit takes precedence.
descriptions.no_m_co_idle_no_catalyst: Without three-way catalyst and lambda sensor: max 3.5 %, or 4.5 % for vehicles registered 1.1.74 to 1.10.86. Vehicles registered before 1974 and two-stroke engines are exempt.
descriptions.no_m_lambda: With three-way catalyst and lambda sensor: 1 ± 0.03, or the manufacturer's specification.
descriptions.no_8_2_2_2: Euro 4 or lower: measure opacity by free acceleration in neutral with the clutch engaged; manufacturer limits take precedence over the general ones. Euro 5 and newer: read OBD with diagnostic equipment; no measurement when the ECU responds, the readiness test is OK and there are no active engine fault codes (P0 to P6). A leak, an aborted test (abnormal running, idle too high, uncertain governed speed) or a modification preventing measurement gives c). Exempt: vehicles registered or first used before 1 Jan 1980. General limits: older than Euro 4, naturally aspirated 2.5 m-1, turbocharged 3.0 m-1; Euro 4/5/EEV 1.5 m-1; Euro 6 or newer 0.7 m-1. Pass after the first acceleration if opacity does not exceed limit x 0.7; otherwise three more accelerations and their mean is the result. Probe at least 3 x pipe diameter deep, preferably at least 20 cm.
descriptions.no_m_opacity_euro6: Max 0.7 m⁻¹. The manufacturer's limit takes precedence. Only measured when the OBD check is not in order.
descriptions.no_m_opacity_euro4_5: Max 1.5 m⁻¹. The manufacturer's limit takes precedence. Euro 5 is only measured when the OBD check is not in order.
descriptions.no_m_opacity_older_na: Max 2.5 m⁻¹. The manufacturer's limit takes precedence.
descriptions.no_m_opacity_older_turbo: Max 3.0 m⁻¹. The manufacturer's limit takes precedence.
descriptions.no_8_2_3_1: With the engine running: check whether the OBD malfunction indicator shows a fault and whether self-diagnosis works correctly; any deviation gives e). Look for visible blue, dark grey or black smoke on the road test and on a throttle blip from idle, and check how the engine runs.
descriptions.no_8_3_1: Grade 2 for any large fluid leak (other than water) likely to harm the environment or be a safety risk for other road users, provided it drips on the ground during the inspection.
descriptions.no_10_1: Given when something requires the vehicle to go to a traffic station for assessment, new approval or an amendment to the registration certificate, e.g. illegal engine or ECU modification, lowered/raised, non-compliant front protection (bull bar), more seats than registered, converted to another fuel or a modification requiring approval. Given in addition to the relevant defect on the same matter; at re-inspection only Statens vegvesen can clear it.
descriptions.bodyConditionMap: Tap the drawing where each dent, scratch or chip is, and add a note and a photo. Marks from earlier visits show in grey.
